name: Sci-Hub
tagline: Provides free access to academic research papers by circumventing publisher paywalls
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Domain seizure and legal action from publishers
Server hosting instability due to legal pressure

news_articles.headline: Sci-Hub: How Does It Work and Why Is It Controversial?

academic_citations: Himmelstein et al. (2018) - 'Sci-Hub provides access to nearly all scholarly literature published within the last 50 years'
documented_limitations: Operates in legal gray area; not a sustainable long-term solution
Does not address underlying systemic issues in academic publishing
Limited metadata quality for some papers
jurisdictional_scope: International but faces legal restrictions in multiple countries
curation_criteria: Automated indexing of academic papers from publisher databases and institutional repositories; no formal curation process
controversies: Copyright infringement lawsuits from major academic publishers (Elsevier, Wiley, etc.)
Debate over whether it constitutes piracy vs. civil disobedience
Concerns about data security and user privacy
legal_regulatory_issues: Multiple ongoing lawsuits from academic publishers; domain blocked in several countries; founder (Alexandra Elbakyan) faces legal action
